candidate_contract.row_identity: target-date row y-center clustered from visible date anchors and rounded into an episode-local visit key
candidate_contract.unvisited_row_policy: when an unvisited target-date row is visible, any tap on an already visited row is rejected before execution and the allowed unvisited y-centers are exposed
candidate_contract.detail_frame_binding: the current detail screenshot is bound to the active row key only when a validated press_back action is accepted
candidate_contract.detail_frame_integrity: every routed detail frame is rehashed and must match its controller-captured SHA-256 before reuse
candidate_contract.transactional_state_policy: row visits and detail-frame captures are committed only after all later action and loop guards pass
candidate_contract.multi_row_answer_location: a multi-row requested-field answer is forbidden from an individual detail page and may be submitted only from the restored target-date list
candidate_contract.visual_field_scope: only an explicitly requested category or type may use a semantically unambiguous conventional icon when text is absent
candidate_contract.visual_adjudication: one same-turn critic jointly inspects the current target-date list and one controller-bound detail frame per distinct row
candidate_contract.row_order_policy: the critic must verify exactly one answer item per target row in top-to-bottom row order

coverage: a repeated tap on the first visited target-date row is rejected before execution
the bounded repair accepts only a visible unvisited target-date row
a detail-page answer is repaired to one exact press_back action
the pre-back detail screenshot is bound to the active target row
two bound detail frames are supplied to the dated-row visual critic
the final answer requires one item per row and a proceed verdict
guard state is not committed when a later loop guard rejects the action

online_boundary_at_validation.interpretation: local validation passed and the route is healthy, but no r65 live smoke is authorized before an exact-package zero-call preflight

allowed: prepare a fresh r65 H17-only development wrapper and namespace
add exact-source freeze and invocation-boundary tests
run a zero-model-call online preflight against the exact r65 package
run at most one non-scored H17 M0 smoke only after that preflight passes
forbidden: resume or overwrite the r64 development suite
launch any formal r65 Gate-F batch
run any r65 development sequence other than its single frozen H17 M0 cell
accept a row title as a different requested field
use hidden task parameters or the offline expected answer
